message.content:
Here’s a quick‑fire guide to make your Friday night frightfully unforgettable. I’ve grouped the picks into three buckets—**Classic Chills**, **Modern Masterpieces**, and **Hidden Gems**—so you can choose whatever vibe you’re after.

| # | Title (Year) | Subgenre | Why It Works | Streaming Hint |
|---|--------------|----------|--------------|----------------|
| 1 | *The Shining* (1980) | Psychological / Supernatural | Iconic score, haunting visuals, Jack Nicholson at his best. | HBO Max (or rent on Amazon Prime Video) |
| 2 | *Hereditary* (2018) | Family‑Terror / Occult | Gripping family drama + supernatural dread; Toni Collette is terrifying. | Netflix (in select regions) |
| 3 | *Get Out* (2017) | Social Commentary / Thriller | Smart satire wrapped in a suspenseful thriller; great twist. | Hulu (or rent on iTunes) |
| 4 | *A Quiet Place* (2018) | Survival / Sci‑Fi | Silence is the new soundtrack; tension builds from the ground up. | Paramount+ |
| 5 | *Midsommar* (2019) | Folk Horror | Daylight dread; unsettling rituals set against bright Swedish landscapes. | Hulu (or rent on Google Play) |
| 6 | *It Follows* (2014) | Urban Legend / Psychological | Simple premise but delivers relentless paranoia. | Amazon Prime Video |
| 7 | *The Babadook* (2014) | Psychological / Mythical Creature | A metaphorical monster that feels real; excellent performances. | Netflix (in select regions) |
| 8 | *Suspiria* (1977) | Giallo / Dance School | Visually stunning, eerie soundtrack, and a cult status. | Criterion Channel |
| 9 | *The Witch* (2015) | Period / Folk Horror | Slow burn, authentic period detail, and an unnerving atmosphere. | Amazon Prime Video |
|10 | *The Conjuring* (2013) | Paranormal Investigation | Classic haunted house story with solid scares and good pacing. | Disney+ (under “Star”) |

### How to Pick:
- **If you want a psychological rollercoaster:** Go for *Hereditary*, *The Babadook*, or *Midsommar*.  
- **For a mix of social critique & chills:** *Get Out* is perfect.  
- **If you love a good jump‑scare plus a strong narrative arc:** *The Conjuring* or *A Quiet Place* will satisfy.  

Feel free to let me know what kind of horror you’re in the mood for (e.g., ghosts, slasher, cosmic horror), and I can narrow it down even further!
